title: LightSplit: Practical Privacy-Preserving Split Learning via Orthogonal Projections (Full Version)
abstract: arXiv:2605.13265v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Split learning (SL) enables collaborative training by partitioning a neural network across clients and a central server. However, the cut-layer interface introduces a key challenge: high-dimensional activations incur substantial communication overhead while exposing representations vulnerable to reconstruction attacks. Existing approaches typically address efficiency or privacy in isolation. We propose LightSplit, which limits information exposure and reduces communication overhead via a lightweight fixed orthogonal random projection at the cut layer. Based on Shannon's information theory, this projection acts as an information bottleneck that restricts instance-specific information and suppresses exploitable per-sample signals. With low-dimensional projections sent instead of raw activations, the server operates on lifted representations without requiring changes to existing SL architectures. translated_title: LightSplit：基于正交投影的实用隐私保护拆分学习（完整版）
translated_abstract: 拆分学习（SL）通过将神经网络划分到客户端和中央服务器之间，实现协作训练。然而，切分层接口带来了一个关键挑战：高维激活值会产生大量的通信开销，同时暴露的表示容易受到重建攻击。现有方法通常只能单独解决效率或隐私问题。我们提出了LightSplit，它在切分层通过轻量级的固定正交随机投影来限制信息暴露并减少通信开销。基于香农信息论，该投影充当一个信息瓶颈，限制实例特定的信息并抑制可被利用的逐样本信号。通过发送低维投影代替原始激活值，服务器在提升后的表示上进行操作，而无需更改现有的拆分学习架构。在不添加任何可训练的客户端组件的情况下，
tldr: LightSplit在切分层采用轻量级的固定正交随机投影作为信息瓶颈，同时降低了拆分学习的通信开销并抵御重建攻击保护隐私。
en_tdlr: LightSplit uses a lightweight fixed orthogonal random projection as an information bottleneck at the cut layer, simultaneously reducing communication overhead and protecting privacy against reconstruction attacks in split learning.
